evals.name: capture-does-not-interrupt
evals.setup: `srd:review` is mid-pass. The SRD claims "the gateway retries 3×"; corpus searches find no document stating any retry count.

evals.name: drain-grill-confirm-file
evals.setup: Two draft gaps with `srd_ref` `specs/gateway.md` sit on the server. Offered them, the finder works them now.

evals.name: an-srd-gap-is-refused
evals.setup: A caller hands over two items together: "the Retention Sweep section cites a 90-day window the platform docs never state" — a real documentation gap — and "GR-7 and GR-9 both specify the lockout threshold and disagree" — a defect inside the SRD, not in the documentation.

evals.name: opt-out-and-duplicate-merge
evals.setup: A second caller session hands over the retry-count gap already a draft for `specs/gateway.md`, with different search terms. At drain the finder says "skip the questions".

evals.name: gate-stops-without-the-server
evals.setup: `project-config.md` names `mcp-server: srd-doc`, but no `mcp__srd-doc__*` tools exist in this session. One draft gap would otherwise be waiting.

evals.name: declined-at-the-confirm-gate
evals.setup: One draft gap. The finder works it, then answers no at the confirmation gate — the record is wrong and they do not want it filed.

evals.name: missing-config-stops-the-run
evals.setup: No `project-config.md` exists in the SRD's directory or any parent directory.

evals.name: heavy-grill-and-session-opt-out
evals.setup: Three draft gaps exist for `specs/gateway.md`. The finder picks heavy for the first, then says "just take the one-liners for the rest of these".

evals.name: drafts-survive-a-new-session
evals.setup: A prior session captured one gap for `specs/gateway.md` as a draft and ended before filing it. This is a fresh session; nothing about the gap exists on this machine.
